collection: Primary4 Igbo basic grammar and original composition
note: Twenty original written structured drafts under eight new limited mappings. Original descriptive/narrative stimuli, revision tasks and complete model compositions. Contexts are fictional; no real visit, match, national writing-length rule or independent native academic approval claimed.

questions.subject: Igbo Language
questions.learningObjective: Explain a simple sentence using a complete one-clause example.
questions.prompt: Kọwaa ahịrịokwu mfe. Nye otu ọmụmaatụ n’asụsụ Igbo, ma kọwaa ihe ọ na-agwa anyị.
questions.answer: Ahịrịokwu mfe nwere otu nkebiahịrị nnoroonwe na nghọta zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ: M na-ese ihe. Ọ na-agwa anyị ihe onye na-ekwu okwu na-eme.
questions.explanation: The explanation and original example focus on one independent clause; simple does not mean merely short.

markingGuide.description: Explains a complete single-clause sentence in intelligible Igbo, using equivalent class-appropriate terminology.
Supplies a grammatical simple sentence, such as the original example.
Explains the message conveyed by that example.

questions.subject: Igbo Language
questions.learningObjective: Explain the meaning and function of verbs, including identity or state as well as action.
questions.prompt: Gịnị bụ ngwaa? Nye otu ọmụmaatụ n’ahịrịokwu, ma kọwaa ọrụ ọ na-arụ n’ebe ahụ.
questions.answer: Ngwaa bụ nkejiasụsụ na-egosi omume ma ọ bụ ọnọdụ. N’ahịrịokwu M na-eri nri, na-eri na-egosi ihe m na-eme.
questions.explanation: Verbs contribute action or state/identity meanings. The task asks for explanation in context, not an action-only definition.

markingGuide.description: Explains verb as a word class expressing action or state in intelligible Igbo.

questions.subject: Igbo Language
questions.learningObjective: Explain descriptive composition and identify its title, introduction, body and conclusion.
questions.prompt: Gụọ Ebe ọgụgụ anyị. Họpụta isiokwu, mmalite na mmechi. Kọwaa otu etiti ederede si enyere onye na-agụ ya aka ịhụ ebe ahụ n’uche.
questions.answer: Isiokwu: Ebe ọgụgụ anyị. Mmalite: N’akụkụ klas anyị e nwere obere ebe ọgụgụ. Mmechi: Ebe a na-enyere anyị aka ịchọta akwụkwọ ma gụọ ya nke ọma. Etiti na-akọwa tebụl, windo, oche na shelf.
questions.explanation: The sections introduce the place, develop concrete features and close with its value to the class. A descriptive text need not recount a sequence of events.

questions.subject: Igbo Language
questions.learningObjective: Explain narrative composition and identify its opening, event development and ending.
questions.prompt: Gịnị bụ edemede akụkọ? Kọwaa ihe mmalite na mmechi ga-enyere onye na-agụ ya aka ịghọta.
questions.answer: Edemede akụkọ na-akọ ihe mere ma ọ bụ ihe e chepụtara. Mmalite na-egosi ndị nọ n’akụkọ na ebe ma ọ bụ oge ihe malitere. Mmechi na-egosi otú ihe si kwụsị.

questions.learningObjective: Explain narrative composition and identify its opening, event development and ending.
questions.prompt: N’Egwuregwu e chepụtara, hụta otu ihe mmalite mere na otu ihe mmechi mere. Kọwaa ihe mere ederede a ji bụrụ akụkọ karịa ndepụta ihe dị n’ama egwuregwu.
questions.answer: Mmalite mere ka anyị mata otu Ugo na otu Enyi na ebe ha zukọrọ. Mmechi gwara anyị na ha ga-egwu ụbọchị ọzọ, e nweghịkwa onye meriri. Ọ bụ akụkọ n’ihi na ọ na-akọ ihe ndị mere n’usoro.
questions.explanation: The original narrative develops an event and its interruption, whereas a descriptive inventory would primarily list features of the venue. It is not a historical match report.

markingGuide.description: Identifies an accurate opening function/detail.

Explains that connected events and their sequence make this a narrative.

questions.passage:
Egwuregwu e chepụtara

questions.subject: Igbo Language
questions.learningObjective: Write and revise an original narrative with a clear sequence and appropriate ending.
questions.prompt: Degharịa akụkọ a ka Uche n’onwe ya bụrụ onye na-akọ ya. Jiri M ma ọ bụ m ebe kwesịrị ekwesị. Agbanwela ihe ndị mere.
questions.answer: M gara n’ama egwuregwu. Ahụrụ m bọọlụ n’akụkụ oche. M nyere onye nlekọta bọọlụ ahụ.

questions.subject: Igbo Language
questions.learningObjective: Write and revise an original narrative with a clear sequence and appropriate ending.
questions.prompt: Chepụta akụkọ gbasara otu klas si hazie ngosi eserese. Dee ya n’asụsụ Igbo. Gosi ihe ha mere mgbe ha chọpụtara na aha ndị sere ụfọdụ eserese adịghị na ha, na otú akụkọ ahụ si kwụsị.
questions.answer:
Ngosi eserese anyị
Klas anyị kwadebere ngosi eserese n’ụlọ akwụkwọ. Anyị tinyere eserese n’elu tebụl.
Mgbe anyị na-ahazi ha, anyị chọpụtara na aha adịghị na ụfọdụ. Onye nkụzi gwara onye ọ bụla ka ọ chọta eserese ya. Anyị dere aha anyị n’elu obere kaadị ma tinye ha n’akụkụ eserese.
Mgbe ndị ọbịa bịara, ha matara onye sere eserese nke ọ bụla. Ngosi ahụ gara nke ọma.
